scope: Proposition A.2 of the manuscript “The Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three” (preprints/The-Kervaire-Invariant-Problem-at-the-Prime-Three-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 309 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4b9f1ff903605ffa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Starting with ∂1 = ∂0 1 and augmentation (A.6), the recursion ∂sg = p − Ants−2(∂s−1p; N), p = ∂0 s g, s ≥ 2, (A.13) defines compatible finite truncations of a completed free resolution of the U-module B. Every call to (A.12) terminates. Cochains of internal weight d ≤ N in this resolution calculate the ordinary normalized-cobar cohomology Ds,d.
